trials.title: Cluster-randomised trial of HEPA versus ionisation/plasma air cleaners on microbial and physicochemical markers in primary school classrooms
trials.note: Head-to-head air-cleaning technology comparison rather than active-vs-sham; PM and bioaerosol endpoints.

primary: Airborne bacteria/virus presence and concentration in classroom air (12 wk/school)
endpoints.note: Primaries are air-quality measurements, not health outcomes; health sits in the secondaries. The cleanest design in the current watch for linking a filtration intervention to a measured PM change.

trials.title: Development of Novel Assessments for Indoor Air Quality Monitoring and Impact on Children's Health - Cohorts in Schools & Biomarkers of Exposure
interventions: OurAir SQ 1750 mobile air purification system
trials.note: Largest school-based sham-controlled purifier trial in state (n=900); cognition primary endpoint; status UNKNOWN past primary completion.

primary: Change in Correct Detection, continuous Performance Test
Change in correct substitutions, Symbol Digit Modalities Test
Change in Memory Span Task score
Change in Signal Detection Test score
endpoints.note: Four cognitive primaries and NO secondary endpoints - no respiratory or biomarker outcome despite 'biomarkers of exposure' in the title. Multiplicity across four co-primaries is unaddressed in the registration.
